# Wooden Legs

Wooden Legs is the cheerful Ponyville furniture salesman who accidentally makes Pinkie Pie's royal-baby secret even harder to keep. He is a minor speaking character in the G4 *Friendship is Magic* television continuity.

- **Appearance:** Tan pegasus stallion, dark gray mane, light blue eyes, and a brown footstool cutie mark. He resembles Crafty Crate, but is cataloged separately. [Pony reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) and [cutie mark catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks).
- **Name and voice:** Wooden Legs is a fandom/wiki name, fitting his furniture business and cutie mark; its original coiner is unverified. The credited role is Furniture Salespony, voiced by Brian Drummond. [Episode credit transcription](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_five).
- **Appearance in the series:** *The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows* (S5E19, October 17, 2015). No additional episode or comic appearances were verified. [Episode listing on Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/the-one-where-pinkie-pie-knows/umc.cmc.5o2dy4p2w156cbx9q22byq0du).

## Important moments

Both dialogue beats occur in the same brief scene in *The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows* (S5E19).

- **A satisfied customer:** He thanks Pinkie for her balloon display and asks her to advertise his crib sale, showing his friendly, business-minded personality.
- **The unfortunate slogan:** Proud of his own advertising copy, he inadvertently reminds Pinkie of the impending royal baby; her screaming leaves him puzzled.
